data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Intessar means 'desirable' or 'lovable'. This name is derived from the root 'ntsr' which connotes a deep sense of affection and attraction. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that a beautiful name carries blessings and enhances the spiritual growth of the child. The name Intessar carries the meaning “Desirable, Lovable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Intessar usually hope their child will grow to embody desirable, lovable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
